properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued November 6 at 12:55PM AST until November 6 at 3:15PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
FFWSJU

The National Weather Service in San Juan has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Cabo Rojo County in Puerto Rico...
Hormigueros County in Puerto Rico...
Lajas County in Puerto Rico...
Las Marias County in Puerto Rico...
Maricao County in Puerto Rico...
Mayaguez County in Puerto Rico...
San German County in Puerto Rico...

* Until 315 PM AST.

* At 1255 PM AST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
San German, Hormigueros, Lajas, Cabo Rojo, Sabana Grande, Mayaguez,
Monte Grande, Puerto Real, Maricao, Sabana Eneas, Betances,
Boqueron, La Parguera, Pole Ojea and Palmarejo.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
properties.area: Cabo Rojo, PR; Hormigueros, PR; Lajas, PR; Las Marias, PR; Maricao, PR; Mayaguez, PR; San German, PR

properties.description:
* WHAT...Arroyo and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...North Central Socorro County in central New Mexico...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...River or stream flows are elevated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 751 AM MST, emergency management reported flooding in the
advisory area from rising river levels along the Rio Puerco. This
will cause arroyo and small stream flooding. Rapid river rises
will cause minor flooding in the advisory area.
- For Rio Puerco at Bernardo:

- For Rio Grande at San Acacia:
